classifications.description: Observation matches authorized canonical title of the candidate with benign punctuation, case, and whitespace tolerance.
Observation matches an authentic, signed, non-revoked CandidateAliasApprovalRecord in the durable ledger.
Observation keyword is completely distinct or represents an accessory / variant not mapped to candidate.
Observation keyword represents a broad generic query or category search without an authentic signed alias record.
Observation specifies a canonical productId that conflicts with candidate canonicalProductId.
Observation belongs to a different workspace tenant or researchRunId.
Observation region differs from candidate target market (e.g. GB vs US).
Observation lacks required authentic origin proof under strict provenance.
Observation date is in the future or occurs after the evaluation asOf cutoff.
Observation is derived from a test mock, synthetic fixture, or demo source.
Candidate requires canonicalProductId but observation has null productId without authentic raw evidenceReference.
Candidate has null canonicalProductId while observation specifies an explicit foreign productId (A10 fix).
